summary: Ship the full template_payload tree in the plate-core wheel and declare PyYAML as a runtime dependency (#1115).
migration_impact: Upgrade plate-core on the patch track; pip install plate-core pulls PyYAML and import-payload plans the full template file set.
migration_guidance: 1. Upgrade plate-core to the release that includes this fix.
2. Re-run gh plate bootstrap --apply or import-payload if a prior incomplete wheel left partial template files.
agent_notes: Wheel packaging now grafts template_payload (including .github and .agentic) via MANIFEST.in; label descriptions are capped at 100 characters for GitHub label sync.
